 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Shekhar Jha
 Oral Order
2 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The accused/petitioner seeks bail in connection with Kochadhaman P.S. Case No. 207 of 2022 registered for the offences under Sections 420, 376, 323, 506, 120(B) and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3, 4, 5 of Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956.
3. The accused/petitioner is named in the First Information Report and is in custody since 05.08.2025.
4. Allegation against the petitioner is to involve in prostitution/immoral trafficking alongwith other co-accused Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.74069 of 2025(2) dt.07-11-2025 persons, where petitioner cooperated the main co-accused namely, Md. Afaque Alam who forced the informant to join prostitution, who is none but the husband of the informant.
Md. Kalam @ Md. Kalam Alam @ Kalam@Kalam ... vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025

entities.text: Md. Kalam @ Md. Kalam Alam @ Kalam@Kalam ... vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner that when matrimonial discord surfaced between the informant and her husband he was implicated with the allegation that he forced her to join prostitution, where this petitioner was also implicated only being the friend of her husband.
6. It is submitted that nothing transpired during investigation qua involvement of this petitioner with the present crime in question.
It is pointed out that even from the FIR itself, except suspicion nothing incriminating appears against this petitioner.
7. Learned A.P.P. for the State has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

8. In view of aforesaid factual submission and by taking note of the fact as the thrust of allegation is available against co-accused namely, Afaque Alam who is none but the husband of the informant where suspicion qua involvement of Patna High Court CR.

dt.07-11-2025 this petitioner prima facie appears to be raised through FIR itself, accordingly,
petitioner above-named is directed to be released on bail, furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessiions Judge, 1 st, Kishanganj/concerned court, in connection with Kochadhaman P.S.
Case No. 207 of 2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C/Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (in short "B.N.S.S.").
(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) Rajeev/-
